name: prompt-manager-delivery-epoch-worker
description: One goal run per epoch (large-effort-orchestration), created by the orchestrator with --until. Runs on the interactive substrate so the runner's native /goal loop keeps it working across turns until the epoch outcome is met (codec-pipe runs end after one turn), and so run continue --message can type into it. Its rules are the worker card large-effort-orchestration/references/worker.md, not the full skill. Works in the shared tree with network access so it can rebuild, run journeys and use Test Genie against its own changes (D5). No per-turn or per-tool caps; the epoch's step-back triggers and token budget bound it.
